description:
Holy grail reissue. French composer Jean Claude Oliver, a famous musician of his time, was maybe the first sitar owner in Paris in the late 60’s. He played on timeless gems such as 'Psychasténie' from Serge Gainsbourg and many other french pop-psyche-jerk tracks.
He had also his own project called Derboukas project in late 60's musical experimentations mixing oriental vibes with eastern bossa or so. A true World Music pioneer in a way ! 
The original 45 with 'Camel Bossa' released in 1968 is impossible to find and B side 'Caravan March' is also a great song from another 45 which combines psychedelic pop grooves with nice cello parts. 
For the very first time these 2 curiosities tracks are officially reissued on a vinyl 45 by Pépite with love !
